input: Draft a neighborhood noise complaint to the council

gold.taskTitle: Draft a Neighborhood Noise Complaint to Council
gold.taskDescription: Write a formal noise complaint letter addressed to the local council about a specific noise issue in the user's neighborhood.

questions.title: What is the specific source of the noise?
questions.description: Identify the exact noise source, such as a construction site, bar, neighbor, or traffic.

questions.title: How long has this noise problem been occurring?
questions.description: Determine the duration and frequency of the noise issue to establish a timeline for the complaint.

questions.title: What are the typical hours when the noise happens?
questions.description: Pinpoint the time of day or night the noise occurs to reference potential bylaw violations.

questions.title: Have you already contacted the noise source directly?
questions.description: Find out if prior attempts were made to resolve the issue before escalating to the council.

questions.title: What is the name of your specific local council or district?
questions.description: Identify the correct council body so the letter is addressed to the right authority.

questions.title: Do you have any evidence such as recordings or logs?
questions.description: Determine whether supporting documentation exists that should be referenced in the complaint.

questions.title: What outcome or action do you want the council to take?
questions.description: Clarify the desired resolution, such as an investigation, fine, enforcement visit, or mediation.
